## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The pull request adds a bounded retry helper and tests for success, exhaustion, and attempt validation. Its ten-attempt limit conflicts with the loaded project requirement of five attempts and must be corrected before merge.

## Critical
- app/net.py:19 — correctness — When an upstream repeatedly raises OSError, the helper permits ten attempts by default, exceeding the loaded AGENTS.md requirement that retry helpers cap attempts at five — A failed request generates twice the permitted upstream calls and prolongs failure handling during outages.
